cards.evacuation.refused: {full} is the set-aside section {evacuation}, so cards cannot be made or moved there (move the cards in it to another section, or delete them)
cards.field.nameControl: {field} cannot have a line break, a tab or another control character
cards.fields.nameNeeded: Each element of fields needs a name
cards.fields.parentMissing: The parent {label}.{parent} is not in fields. To nest, include the parent with type: object in the same fields
cards.fields.parentNotObject: {label}.{parent} is of type {t}, so a field cannot be made inside it. To nest, make the parent type object
cards.fits.notHeld: Section {section} is a {label} section, so {kind} cannot be put there. {hint}
cards.fits.rootCard: {name} is the root, so a card cannot be put there. {hint}
cards.fits.rootGhost: {name} is the root, so a card ghost cannot be put there. Put it in a section under the root
cards.home.appDraws: "{kind}" ({label}) is a card the app draws in diagrams, so it cannot be made
cards.home.none: This project has no section that can hold {kind} (list a section of a kind that holds {kind} in project_tree of the value of project_update. The current order is projectTree of project_read; the kinds are in kind_list)
